Kedarkantha Trek 4N/5D
Pickup: Prince Chowk, near Dehradun Railway Station, 7 am
Day 1 – Dehradun to Sankri (1,967 m). 8 to 9 hour drive, dinner and overnight stay in a Sankri guesthouse. Meet your trek leader for a briefing.
Day 2 – Sankri to Juda ka Talab (2,775 m). About 4 km, 4 to 5 hours. Steepest climb of the trek. Camp by the lake.
Day 3 – Juda ka Talab to Kedarkantha Base Camp (3,430 m). Short acclimatisation day, 3 to 4 hours. Leader checks fitness and oxygen levels.
Day 4 – Base camp to Kedarkantha Summit (3,810 m), descent to Hargaon (2,713 m). Start before dawn for sunrise, 7 to 8 hours.
Day 5 – Hargaon to Sankri, then drive to Dehradun. Expected drop at Prince Chowk around 7 to 8 PM.
